purpose: Independent false-positive / false-negative control for corporate-action contract 2.0.0 (review R1/R13 of #722). Labels come from data that the mechanism does not use to decide: SEC XBRL shares outstanding (a different SEC dataset than the 8-K text), the price provider's own split factor (another vendor's record) and, for holds, SEC statements with a matching ratio near the date.

selection.universe: all segments of the canonical capture that reproduces freeze V4-beae51ae1b07768b (same source objects)
controlCategoriesExcludeInSample: every segment with a security-month in the V4 extreme population (2213 security-months, the 83 diagnostic cases included)
every segment among the 74 adjusted-level > 1e6 securities
every segment on which canonical-total-return-1.2.0 places a SPLIT_SUSPECTED_UNDECLARED or PRICE_SPIKE_REVERTED hold
selection.precisionAndFalseNegativesUseWholeUniver: hold/normalize precision and the false-negative population are measured over every segment (in-sample flagged and reported separately), not only the control categories

categories.VOLATILE: top decile of the standard deviation of daily raw log returns (days without a provider event), median raw close >= 1
categories.HIGH_BETA_MOVE: at least one session with raw close/close >= 1.5 or <= 1/1.5 and no provider event that day
categories.STALE: at least 10 consecutive sessions with an identical raw close
categories.MERGER: delisted segment with delisting class ACQUISITION or MERGER_FORM (R15 SEC classification)
categories.BANKRUPTCY_DISTRESS: delisted segment with delisting class DEREGISTRATION_WITH_DISTRESS
categories.SYMBOL_CHANGE: segment whose issuer CIK has another segment with a different ticker starting within 30 days after this segment ends

labels.sharesAcross: SEC shares outstanding: last report before and first report on/after the date, both within 200 days of it; sr = after/before
labels.sharesLabel: NO_SPLIT if |ln sr| < ln 1.25; CONFIRMS if the ratio q explains 1/sr better than no event (|ln(1/sr) + ln q| < |ln(1/sr)|); OTHER_CHANGE otherwise; NONE without reports
labels.HOLD: price-based hold (PRICE_DISCONTINUITY_NO_CA_EVIDENCE, PROBABLE_CORPORATE_ACTION, CONFLICTING_CORPORATE_ACTION). TRUE_POSITIVE: an SEC split statement (any stage) whose ratio explains the raw move, dated within 15 days (or filed within 120 days if undated), or sharesLabel CONFIRMS. FALSE_POSITIVE: sharesLabel NO_SPLIT and no SEC split statement or reverse-split proxy within 365 days. Otherwise UNLABELED.
labels.NORMALIZE: TRUE_POSITIVE if sharesLabel CONFIRMS, FALSE_POSITIVE if NO_SPLIT, otherwise UNLABELED (the SEC 8-K that triggered the normalization is not used as its own label)
labels.UNLABELED_ALWAYS: segments without issuer CIK and interventions before 2001-06-01 (no EDGAR full-text coverage)
labels.FALSE_NEGATIVE_POPULATION: every pair of consecutive SEC share-count reports (<= 200 days apart, inside the segment) with sr <= 1/3 (a reverse-split-sized drop of shares outstanding); share-count rises >= 3 are counted but not scored (issuance cannot be told from forward splits)
labels.FALSE_NEGATIVE: inside that window and inside the v2 valid range a session whose canonical gross total return g satisfies ln g >= |ln sr| / 2 (an unadjusted reverse-split-sized jump remains in canonical data); HELD if the v2 hold starts inside the window (data loss, reported, not a false negative); HANDLED otherwise
labels.extractorRecall: provider split factors (|ln f| >= ln 1.5, from 2002, issuer CIK) for which the SEC extractor found an EFFECTIVE event of the same ratio (1 %) dated within 7 days (reported; not an acceptance criterion)

acceptance.secCollectionComplete: every EDGAR search page and every document read without error, no document cap hit
acceptance.pitConsistency: zero violations: no bar after the as-of date, no hold observed after it, no normalization from a filing on or after it, and no return of the as-of view differing from the final view except the event-day return of a later-filed SEC normalization
acceptance.intervals: Wilson 95 % reported with every rate; acceptance on the point estimate
acceptance.noTuning: no threshold, window or tolerance of sec-corporate-actions.js, corporate-action-validation.js, canonical-price-validity.js or canonical-total-return.js is changed after the run; a failed acceptance is reported as NOT_READY
